name: Landing tick jump: a jump on the landing tick keeps the momentum ground friction takes a tick later
techNote: The dot starts in the air (x -300, y 80) with momentum.x 2000 (a spring's or a dash's leftover), stick right, over a floor (top y 0, x -400-400); past it a spike pit (strip x 400-1470, y -432 to -400) and a platform (top y -300, x 1470-1900) with the finish box on it. Ground friction on momentum.x (x0.75 a tick on metal, touchedSolidGround 2193-2199) runs only on ground ticks where onGround was already on, so the landing tick (tick 12) keeps it all. A jump pressed 4 ticks early (buffered) leaves on the landing tick with momentum.x 1448.2 and lands on the platform (x 1528 at y -268). One tick later (tick 13) friction has taken it to 1058: the same jump is 130 u short at the platform's height, hits its side and falls into the spikes.
